# FlowBaton

> YAML flows for Android and iOS Simulator UI tests. One Go binary. Optional
> AI with your own key. SLSA-attested releases. Apache-2.0. Pre-alpha.

A flow is a YAML file: an `appId` header, `---`, then a list of commands such
as `launchApp`, `tapOn`, `inputText`, `assertVisible`. Validate any flow with
`flowbaton check-syntax <file|->` before running it. Run flows with
`flowbaton test -p android|ios --device <id> <flow.yaml>`. The binary also
serves MCP tools over stdio via `flowbaton mcp`.
